Note — I2VA PROMPT FORMAT
widgets_values:
I2VA PROMPT FORMAT

SCENE 1 — IMAGE CONDITIONED
Start with the exact first-frame alignment sentence:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

Then use integrated_multimodal_description, overall_soundscape, and non_diegetic_music.

SCENE 2+ — MOTION CONTEXT ONLY
The First-Scene Image Gate removes the image after scene 1. Do not mention Picture 1 in continuation prompts. Continue the incoming pose/action phase, viewpoint, weapon/object state, camera motion, environment, lighting, ambience, and screen geography without a reset.

MiniMax H3 Image to Video — CORE I2VA — IMAGE ONLY ON SCENE 1
widgets_values:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Classic Doom 1993 First Person Shooter video game gameplay footage, of a World War 2 battle scenario - Market Garden - parachuting in and landing and going into combat.

Timeline:
[0s-8s] The perspective descends while moving forward quickly, landing on the outskirts of the city near a building. The older parachuting soldiers also descend and land in various places. Another solider lands nearby the viewer.
[8s-9s] The viewer's hands drop as the parachute falls behind the point of view, and a M1 Garand rifle is pulled into view in the center, aiming forward.
[9s-12s] The perspective moves as the viewer runs to nearby cover, where a friendly soldier is firing into a dark building ahead, filled with German soliders.
[12s-15s] The viewer fires several times into the window, successfully shooting a German soldier who falls out of view in the window.

overall_soundscape: There are many explodes of flak can be heard, as well as gunfire. Low humming World War 2 planes overhead can be heard.

non_diegetic_music: A low volume World War 2 era fanfare is playing, accompanying the action.

widgets_values:
I2V NORMAL — QUICK START

Use the stable Scene Prompt Editor for both prompts; Rich Scene Prompt Editor and its optional agent optimizer are intentionally absent.

1. Copy example_workflows/assets/jigen_market_garden_doom_opening.png to ComfyUI/input and select it in PICTURE 1.
2. Keep the First-Scene Image Gate connected. It sends Picture 1 only to scene 1; scene 2 is driven by Motion Context.
3. Scene 1 is the credited 15-second Banodoco prompt. Scene 2 is a repository-authored 15-second continuation and intentionally contains no Picture 1 reference.
4. Queue and review each scene. Final Assemble preserves generated audio.

TIMING
Each 15-second request is 362 raw H3 frames. Scene 2 repeats 22 context frames, so delivery is 362 + (362 - 22) = 702 frames = 29.25 seconds at 24 fps.

BLENDING
video_blend_frames = 0 trims the repeated context at a hard boundary without an additional crossfade.

Note — RECOVERY / ASSEMBLE LATER
widgets_values:
The two amber recovery nodes are MUTED by default.

If all segments finished but final assembly did not, mute the main green Assemble node, enable both recovery nodes, and queue. They validate every SHA-256 checkpoint pair and assemble without rerendering the completed clips.

For an interrupted generation, leave recovery muted and set Loop Start's start_clip to the first unfinished clip.
